strings.zh: 等我们培养好了精灵之后{NEWLINE}再来一场对战吧！{SCROLL}在此之前先交换一下电话号码吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: We should both train our Pokémon some{NEWLINE}more and have another battle!{SCROLL}So we should really exchange phone{NEWLINE}numbers. Don’t you agree? {VAR:0200:0}
Oh, don’t you have any confidence that{NEWLINE}you can beat me again?

strings.zh: 嗯？你是来登录{NEWLINE}电话号码的吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Hmm? Did you decide that you want{NEWLINE}my phone number after all? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哎？你不觉得{NEWLINE}电话里声音变大了吗？{CLEAR}难道⋯⋯你就在附近？
strings.en: Huh? Is it just me, or does your voice{NEWLINE}seem unusually loud?{CLEAR}Don’t tell me...you’re nearby?

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}长得越来越可爱了,{CLEAR}就像我一样！{SCROLL}它的实力也变强了,{NEWLINE}像{VAR:0100:11}什么的,{CLEAR}完全能轻松搞定！{SCROLL}现在我也想去满金市道馆挑战一下了。{SCROLL}再见了！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} is looking more and{NEWLINE}more like me. It’s getting cuter!{SCROLL}And, you know?{NEWLINE}Now we can KO {VAR:0100:11} easily.{SCROLL}I should challenge the Goldenrod Gym.{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}长得越来越可爱了,{CLEAR}就像我一样！{SCROLL}还有,{NEWLINE}前段时间,就差那么一点点{CLEAR}我就能打赢{VAR:0100:11}了。{SCROLL}看来我训练还不够啊。{SCROLL}再见了！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} is looking more and{NEWLINE}more like me. It’s getting cuter!{SCROLL}And, you know?{NEWLINE}We just failed to beat {VAR:0100:11} by{CLEAR}a tiny margin.{SCROLL}I’m guessing my Pokémon’s levels{NEWLINE}aren’t high enough yet...{SCROLL}See you later!

strings.zh: 你现在应该很强了吧,{NEWLINE}让我们再来比试比试怎么样！{SCROLL}我现在在{VAR:0104:3},{NEWLINE}来一场精灵对战吧。
strings.en: You must be a lot better now, huh?{SCROLL}How about showing me your technique{NEWLINE}in a real battle with me?{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting on {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 喂喂,你怎么了？{NEWLINE}快点来和我对战啊。{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你呢！
strings.en: Where are you?{NEWLINE}Let’s have our battle soon!{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting on {VAR:0104:3}.

strings.zh: 喂喂！{SCROLL}满金市百货商店６楼{NEWLINE}进行的抽奖活动好刺激啊！
strings.en: Hello!{SCROLL}You know, I was on the sixth floor of{NEWLINE}the Goldenrod Department Store trying{CLEAR}out the drawing. It’s so exciting!
